budgets.project_summary: Mobile banking API with OAuth 2.0 authentication and PSD2 compliance

components.name: OAuth 2.0 authentication backend
components.description: Implementation of OAuth 2.0 flows (authorization code, refresh token) with JWT-based session management, multi-tenant token isolation, and rate limiting per client.

components.name: PSD2 strong customer authentication
components.description: Strong Customer Authentication per PSD2 RTS: dynamic linking of amount and payee, two-factor challenge via push notification with SMS fallback, and exemption handling for low-value and trusted-beneficiary payments.

components.name: Account and balance aggregation endpoints
components.description: Read-only REST endpoints exposing account details, current and available balances, and paginated transaction history, backed by a read replica to keep reporting load off the transactional database.

components.name: Immutable audit trail
components.description: Append-only audit log of every authentication decision and money movement, hash-chained so tampering is detectable, with a seven-year retention policy and export tooling for the regulator.

components.name: Developer portal and OpenAPI documentation
components.description: Public OpenAPI 3.1 specification generated from the route definitions, published through a self-service developer portal with sandbox credentials and example requests.

budgets.project_summary: Core banking ledger migration from a mainframe batch system to an event-sourced service

components.name: Event-sourced double-entry ledger
components.description: Double-entry ledger built on an append-only event store, with deterministic projections for account balances and a replay mechanism that rebuilds any balance as of an arbitrary point in time.

components.name: Mainframe extraction and dual-run reconciliation
components.description: Nightly extraction of COBOL fixed-width files from the mainframe, loaded into the new ledger and reconciled line by line against the legacy balances, with a dashboard listing every discrepancy above one cent.

components.name: SEPA settlement adapter
components.description: Outbound SEPA Credit Transfer and Direct Debit file generation, inbound return and reject handling, and cut-off window scheduling aligned with the clearing house calendar.

components.name: Observability and reconciliation alerting
components.description: Distributed tracing across the ingestion and projection pipelines, with alerting on projection lag, unbalanced journals, and failed settlement batches routed to the on-call rota.

components.name: Cutover runbook and rollback plan
components.description: Documented cutover procedure with go/no-go checkpoints, a rehearsed rollback to the mainframe within a four-hour window, and a freeze plan for the weekend of the switch.

budgets.project_summary: Payment orchestration layer routing card transactions across several acquirers

components.name: Acquirer routing engine
components.description: Rule-based routing of each authorization to the cheapest acquirer that is currently healthy, with automatic retry against a secondary acquirer on soft declines and a circuit breaker per provider.

components.name: Card tokenisation vault
components.description: PCI-DSS compliant vault storing card data encrypted with per-tenant keys in a hardware security module, exposing only network tokens to the rest of the platform.

components.name: Acquirer webhook ingestion
components.description: Idempotent ingestion of asynchronous acquirer notifications for captures, refunds and chargebacks, with signature verification, out-of-order delivery handling and a replay queue for failed deliveries.

components.name: Daily settlement reconciliation
components.description: Matching of acquirer settlement reports against internal authorizations, flagging missing captures and fee discrepancies, and producing an accounting export for the finance team.

components.name: Merchant dashboard
components.description: Self-service dashboard where merchants inspect transaction status, issue partial refunds and download settlement statements, with role-based access per merchant account.

budgets.project_summary: Credit scoring service exposing model predictions with explainability and audit guarantees

components.name: Feature store and point-in-time joins
components.description: Offline and online feature store sharing one definition per feature, with point-in-time correct joins so training data never leaks information that was unavailable at decision time.

components.name: Scoring inference API
components.description: Low-latency scoring endpoint serving a gradient boosting model, with model version pinning per request, shadow deployment of challenger models and a p99 budget of 120 milliseconds.

components.name: Decision explainability output
components.description: Per-decision SHAP contributions translated into the plain-language adverse action reasons required when a credit application is refused, stored alongside the decision itself.

components.name: Population drift monitoring
components.description: Scheduled comparison of live feature distributions against the training baseline, raising an alert when the population stability index of any feature crosses the agreed threshold.

components.name: Model governance register
components.description: Register recording every model version, its training dataset hash, validation results and the approver who signed it off, exportable for the internal model risk review.

budgets.project_summary: Headless commerce replatform of a fashion retailer with 40000 SKUs

components.name: Product catalogue service
components.description: Catalogue service modelling products, variants and option matrices, with scheduled price lists per market and a publish workflow that keeps unreleased collections invisible to the storefront.

components.name: Faceted search and merchandising
components.description: Search over the catalogue with faceted filtering by size, colour and material, synonym handling for fashion vocabulary, and manual pinning of promoted products per category.

components.name: Cart and checkout API
components.description: Stateless cart with server-side price revalidation at checkout, promotion stacking rules, guest checkout and address validation against the carrier's deliverability service.

components.name: Inventory synchronisation with the warehouse
components.description: Near real-time stock synchronisation from the warehouse management system, with reservation on add-to-cart, oversell protection and a nightly full reconciliation.

components.name: Storefront caching and image delivery
components.description: Edge caching strategy for category and product pages with surrogate key invalidation on publish, plus responsive image derivatives generated on first request.

budgets.project_summary: Marketplace seller portal with commission settlement for an organic produce platform

components.name: Seller onboarding and KYC
components.description: Onboarding flow collecting tax identifiers and bank details, with document upload, automated identity verification through a third-party provider and manual review for rejected applications.

components.name: Listing management and moderation
components.description: Interface for sellers to publish and edit listings, with a moderation queue that holds listings matching restricted keywords until a marketplace operator approves them.

components.name: Commission calculation and payouts
components.description: Per-category commission rules applied to each completed order, aggregated into fortnightly payouts, with a split payment integration that credits the seller net of fees.

components.name: Buyer ratings and dispute handling
components.description: Rating collection after delivery, weighted seller score, and a dispute workflow that freezes the disputed amount in the next payout until the case is resolved.

budgets.project_summary: Storefront and checkout revamp focused on conversion and Core Web Vitals

components.name: Server-side rendered product pages
components.description: Incremental static regeneration of product and category pages with per-market revalidation, trimming largest contentful paint below two seconds on a mid-range mobile device.

components.name: One-page checkout
components.description: Single-page checkout with inline validation, saved addresses, wallet payment buttons and an abandoned-checkout recovery email triggered thirty minutes after drop-off.

components.name: A/B testing framework
components.description: Server-side experiment assignment with sticky bucketing per visitor, exposure events streamed to the analytics warehouse and a guardrail that halts an experiment on a significant revenue drop.

components.name: Accessibility remediation
components.description: Remediation of the storefront to WCAG 2.2 level AA: keyboard navigation through the full purchase path, focus management in modals and corrected colour contrast across the design tokens.

budgets.project_summary: Subscription box platform with recurring billing and churn analytics

components.name: Subscription lifecycle engine
components.description: State machine covering trial, active, paused, dunning and cancelled subscriptions, with proration on plan changes and a scheduled job that advances each subscription on its own billing anchor.

components.name: Dunning and involuntary churn recovery
components.description: Retry schedule for failed recurring charges aligned with issuer behaviour, card network updater integration and a sequence of reminder emails before the subscription is suspended.

components.name: Monthly fulfilment planning
components.description: Generation of the monthly pick list per warehouse from active subscriptions and selected preferences, with a cut-off date that freezes changes and a carrier label export.

components.name: Churn and cohort analytics
components.description: Cohort retention curves and revenue churn reporting over the subscription event history, surfaced as a dashboard the growth team can filter by acquisition channel.

budgets.project_summary: HL7 and FHIR interoperability layer between hospital systems and a patient portal

components.name: HL7 v2 message ingestion
components.description: MLLP listener receiving ADT, ORU and ORM messages from the hospital information system, with acknowledgement semantics, message deduplication and a dead-letter store for malformed segments.

components.name: FHIR R4 resource mapping
components.description: Mapping of ingested HL7 segments onto FHIR R4 Patient, Encounter, Observation and DiagnosticReport resources, validated against the national implementation guide profiles.

components.name: Patient consent management
components.description: Consent register controlling which categories of clinical data each patient has agreed to share with the portal, enforced at query time rather than at ingestion so a withdrawal takes effect immediately.

components.name: Pseudonymisation for the analytics export
components.description: Export pipeline replacing direct identifiers with stable pseudonyms before clinical data reaches the research environment, keeping the re-identification table inside the hospital network.

components.name: Patient portal read API
components.description: Authenticated API serving a patient their own appointments, lab results and discharge reports, with results withheld until a clinician has released them.

budgets.project_summary: Appointment scheduling suite integrated with an existing electronic health record

components.name: Multi-resource scheduling engine
components.description: Scheduling engine that books a clinician, a room and any required equipment as a single atomic slot, honouring working calendars, overbooking rules per speciality and minimum turnaround between patients.

components.name: EHR integration adapter
components.description: Bidirectional adapter keeping appointments in step with the incumbent electronic health record, reconciling conflicting edits by last-writer-wins with a manual review queue for clinical overrides.

components.name: Appointment reminders
components.description: Reminder campaigns by SMS and email at configurable intervals, with confirmation and cancellation links that free the slot automatically and a no-show flag written back to the patient record.

components.name: Waiting list automation
components.description: Waiting list that offers freed slots to eligible patients in priority order, with a response window after which the offer passes to the next candidate.

budgets.project_summary: Telemedicine platform for remote consultations with clinical note taking

components.name: Video consultation service
components.description: WebRTC consultation rooms with a virtual waiting area, adaptive bitrate for poor rural connections, and a reconnection flow that preserves the session when a patient drops off the network.

components.name: Symptom triage questionnaire
components.description: Adaptive questionnaire completed before the consultation, routing urgent presentations straight to a clinician and attaching the structured answers to the consultation record.

components.name: Clinical note capture and coding
components.description: Structured note template per consultation type with ICD-10 code lookup, amendment history that never overwrites a signed note, and electronic signature on completion.

components.name: Electronic prescription issuing
components.description: Issuing of electronic prescriptions to the national prescription registry, with interaction checks against the patient's active medication and a signed audit entry per issued prescription.

budgets.project_summary: Pharmacovigilance case intake and regulatory reporting system

components.name: Adverse event intake from multiple channels
components.description: Unified intake of suspected adverse reactions arriving by web form, email and call centre transcript, normalised into a single case record with duplicate detection across channels.

components.name: MedDRA coding support
components.description: Assisted coding of reported terms to MedDRA preferred terms, with a reviewer confirmation step and a versioned dictionary so historical cases keep the coding in force when they were assessed.

components.name: E2B R3 regulatory submission
components.description: Generation and transmission of ICH E2B R3 safety reports to the national agency and EudraVigilance, with acknowledgement tracking and automatic resubmission on technical rejection.

components.name: Reporting deadline tracking
components.description: Tracking of the fifteen and ninety day regulatory clocks per case, with escalation to the qualified person for pharmacovigilance when a case approaches its deadline.

budgets.project_summary: Manufacturing execution system integration for a steel rolling plant

components.name: OPC-UA shop floor connectivity
components.description: OPC-UA client subscribing to tag changes on the rolling mill PLCs, buffering locally during network outages and replaying the backlog in order once connectivity returns.

components.name: Production order dispatch
components.description: Dispatch of production orders from the ERP to the line terminals, with sequencing by furnace campaign, material availability checks and operator confirmation of each completed batch.

components.name: OEE and downtime analysis
components.description: Calculation of overall equipment effectiveness per line and shift, with automatic downtime classification from machine states and an operator interface to annotate the cause.

components.name: Quality certificate generation
components.description: Generation of the mill test certificate per coil from measured chemical and mechanical properties, with digital signature and traceability back to the heat number.

components.name: Edge deployment and failover
components.description: Containerised deployment on redundant industrial edge gateways inside the plant network, with automatic failover and a read-only mode that keeps the line running if the central system is unreachable.

budgets.project_summary: IoT telemetry ingestion and anomaly detection for water treatment plants

components.name: MQTT telemetry ingestion
components.description: Ingestion of sensor telemetry from six thousand devices over MQTT with per-device authentication, backpressure handling and downsampling of high-frequency channels before storage.

components.name: Anomaly detection on sensor streams
components.description: Streaming detection of drift and sudden excursions in turbidity and chlorine readings, with per-site thresholds learned from historical behaviour instead of a single global rule.

components.name: Over-the-air firmware updates
components.description: Staged firmware rollout to device fleets with signed images, canary cohorts, automatic rollback on boot failure and a hard block on updating a device while its plant is in an alarm state.

components.name: Alarm routing and on-call escalation
components.description: Routing of plant alarms to the duty technician by severity, with acknowledgement tracking, escalation after an unacknowledged interval and suppression of alarm storms from a single root cause.

budgets.project_summary: Operator interface and safety interlocks for a robotic assembly cell

components.name: Operator human-machine interface
components.description: Touch panel interface showing cell state, current recipe and cycle counters, designed for gloved operation and readable under the shop floor lighting conditions.

components.name: Safety interlock supervision
components.description: Supervision of light curtains, door switches and emergency stops with a documented stop category per zone, plus the validation evidence required for the machinery directive conformity file.

components.name: Recipe management and changeover
components.description: Versioned assembly recipes with guided changeover steps, tool verification before the cell restarts and a locked audit record of who approved each recipe revision.

components.name: Part traceability logging
components.description: Per-part logging of serial number, torque and vision inspection results, exported nightly to the customer quality system and retained locally for ten years.
